body:
> **RE-DERIVED [2026-09-05] — 650 rows read, and four things on this page are
> wrong.** The count correction (2026-09-04) fixed the number and said so:
> *"the prose below was written against the one-sided thread and has not been
> re-derived."* This reads Dan's 358 messages. The corrections are below in the
> order they matter.

**"Mohammed Bin Salman" is a joke about a real person's background, and the
page has been coy about which joke.** He is **Moroccan and Muslim**, says so
himself, and Dan's register with him runs to *"You can take the Muslim out of
the Moroccan / But you can't take the faggot out of the Muslim"* (2024-08-11) —
returned with a flat *"You can."* He lives in **Brooklyn**. `relationship_to_dan`
was `unknown`; he is a close friend, and the thread is one of the corpus's
warmest.

**The friendship is at least eighteen months older than this page's first
contact.** The thread opens **2023-08-11** — *"WHEN ARE YOU COMING TO PLAY
WARZONE WITH ME"*, seven weeks before the 2023-09-29 date the page carried —
and on 2023-12-05, when MBS mentions buying a PS5, Dan's reaction is *"I can't
fucking believe you got a console and didn't tell me. **I've been begging you to
do this for like a year and a half**."* The relationship therefore starts around
mid-2022 and the corpus catches it late.

**The Au Za'atar link is not speculative.** The page hedged it as
*"possibly … an Au Za'atar-adjacent nickname."* On **2023-10-15** Dan tells him
to keep November 1 free: *"Birthday party / With the au zaatar crew"* — Dan's
own birthday, and this friend is invited to it. On **2023-12-05**: *"I just left
au zaatar."* He is inside [[wiki/work/au-zaatar|that circle]].

**Part of this thread is not writeable here.** The 2024-08-11 exchange is a
direct solicitation into the arrangement and is squarely covered by the standing
directive in `CLAUDE.md`; it is read and not written up. Note where the
constraint sat: `bin/wiki-crosslink rederive` flags a page by how often the
page names her, and this page names her **not once** — the constrained material
was entirely in the unread half. **A page can be directive-constrained without
looking it**, and the flag cannot see that until somebody reads the thread.

## The Xanax exchange, which the page had backwards

The page summarised 2023-12-16 as *"a matter-of-fact exchange comparing Xanax to
cocaine that reads as two people genuinely comparing notes."* It is not a
comparison of current use. Dan says *"I need to go take a Xanax now"*, MBS asks
*"u on xanax now / hows that compared to good ol snow"*, and the answer opens
**"I mean I was joking about taking it literally."** What follows is
retrospective, and it is the fullest first-person account of benzodiazepine use
anywhere in the corpus:

> *"You melt into whatever furniture you are sitting in."*
>
> *"And there's a really weird thing where if you take more than you should, you
> completely and totally lose short term memory. I can't tell you how many times
> I repeated the same story to someone 5 minutes after I just told them when I
> was doing Xanax. And then forgot I did THAT and did it again.,.and again."*

**And it dates a cessation with a reason that is not desire.** *"But I had
stopped taking it before everyone realized you could just use a microgram of
fentanyl and press fake 900000 Xanax bars."* The stop is placed before the
pressed-fentanyl era, and the risk model he gives is specific: *"Something like
95% of Xanax is pressed fentanyl now"*, *"Every dead rapper you've heard about
is from that"*, and a distinction between adulteration for profit and
adulteration that kills — *"'Stepped on' to me is like cutting something with
isotol or baby laxative to increase the profit."* The 95% figure is recorded in
the testimony ledger rather than repeated as fact here; it is a claim about the
world, not about him.

## The argument about practice, which is the page's real find

**2023-12-10**, arguing that you improve by drilling rather than by playing:

> *"You get better by doing the stuff you absolutely hate. Spending hours in
> practice range. Learning recoil patterns. And most importantly —"*

MBS cuts him off: *"F off with that shit … Ive been in the range like 1% of the
time."* And Dan's next three messages are the whole of
[[wiki/mind/synthesis/twitter-2024-cognitive-state]]'s adversarial-historian
move, executed live in a video-game argument:

> *"Well admittedly — the evidence is on your side here — because you're always
> way better than I am. **But still —**"*
>
> *"Okay hear me out though. Battle royale is different. Because if you are
> dying right away, you never get the chance to shoot enough rounds to learn the
> recoil."*

**Concede the counterexample explicitly, name whose evidence it is, then narrow
the claim to the domain where it survives.** The subject is Fortnite recoil and
the operation is the one that page documents against politics and
[[wiki/self/twitter/2011|the 2011 rapture posts]] against religion. It is also a
clean [[wiki/mind/concepts/calibrated-confidence]] instance: the concession is
unprompted and costs him the argument's strong form.

## Beyond the games

The friendship has real personal register underneath the gaming banter: a
January 2024 *"shieet bro i been stressed outta my mind lately"*, a shared joke
about being broke, and the December 2023 Xanax exchange read in full above.
Political and cultural asides surface unprompted — a passing comment about
Palestine/Algeria territorial disputes, a joking reference to "Modi and dj" —
and a recurring "md" appears in a dream he recounts, possibly the same contact
documented at [[wiki/people/md]] (unconfirmed link) or an
[[wiki/work/au-zaatar|Au Za'atar]]-adjacent nickname.

**The direction of favours runs one way and Dan keeps score of it.** MBS buys
the cinema tickets — Oppenheimer, then *"Dune 2 imax?"* (2024-02-20) — and Dan
brings the debt up twice, months apart, each time attached to something he is
offering: *"first of all I still owe you for the movie tickets"* when gifting a
Fortnite battle pass (2023-12-05), and *"Also I still owe you for Oppenheimer
tickets so"* in August 2024. The generosity is real and it is instrumental,
which is the pattern [[wiki/mind/synthesis/estate-money-spine]] documents at
scale: the affective half of altruism runs at 0.45x baseline here and the
offering-resources half at 1.79–2.49x.

**Two dated details worth keeping.** *"I play until like 4am everyday"*
(2023-12-05) — recorded in the testimony ledger and **partly false**: 32.4% of
Dan's December 2023 messages do fall between midnight and 05:59, but only 3 of
31 days reach 04:00. And *"I trained an ai to analyze my convo with Sergio"*
(2024-06-25), which puts the practice documented at
[[wiki/mind/synthesis/ai-collaborative-analysis]] into a throwaway line to a
friend two years before the wiki existed.

**The purchase trigger, stated in advance.** He was on a PS4 through 2023 and
had a named condition for replacing it: *"That was my marker for when I NEEDED
to get a ps5. I could live with a ps4 until gta6"* (2023-12-05, on the GTA 6
trailer). A wanted object with an external release date attached to it, rather
than a price.
